content.value_statement: Agent teams need reliable measurements before changing prompts, tools, or models. This skill helps define rubrics, test sets, quality gates, and monitoring workflows.
actual_capabilities: Defines multi-dimensional rubrics for accuracy, completeness, citations, source quality, and tool efficiency.
Explains deterministic validation before LLM-based quality judgment.
Guides creation of stratified test sets across simple, medium, complex, and very complex tasks.
Provides a Python evaluator for scoring outputs, running test sets, and summarizing results.
Describes production monitoring with sampling, pass-rate thresholds, and alert categories.
limitations: Does not design LLM judge prompts, pairwise comparison methods, or bias mitigation in depth.
Example code uses heuristic scoring and should be adapted before production use.
Does not run evaluations by itself without task data, outputs, and expected criteria.
Does not replace human review for edge cases or high-stakes quality decisions.

use_cases.title: Create Regression Suites
use_cases.description: Build repeatable tests that compare agent output quality across prompt, tool, and model changes.

use_cases.title: Compare Configuration Changes
use_cases.description: Measure whether a new agent configuration improves quality without hiding failures in one aggregate score.

use_cases.title: Monitor Production Quality
use_cases.description: Plan sampling, pass-rate thresholds, and alerts for deployed agent systems.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Rubric
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for one agent task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the evaluation skill to create a rubric for this agent task. Include accuracy, completeness, source quality, and pass criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Regression Test Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the evaluation skill to design a regression test set for my agent. Include complexity strata, expected outcomes, and failure categories.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Quality Gate
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced release control for agent changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the evaluation skill to define a quality gate for this agent release. Separate deterministic checks from rubric-based quality judgments.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Continuous Evaluation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the evaluation skill to plan continuous production evaluation. Include sampling strategy, pass-rate thresholds, dashboards, and human review points.

output_examples.input: Evaluate a research assistant that must answer with citations.
output: A rubric covering factual accuracy, completeness, citation accuracy, source quality, and tool efficiency.
A recommendation to run deterministic citation checks before any LLM judgment.
A pass threshold with separate minimums for citation accuracy and factual accuracy.

output_examples.input: Compare two prompt versions for a support agent.
output: A stratified test set with simple, medium, complex, and long-context cases.
A baseline comparison plan that reports per-dimension changes and regressions.
A release gate that blocks changes with lower completeness or critical accuracy failures.

output_examples.input: Monitor quality for a deployed agent workflow.
output: A sampling plan for production interactions with human review for unusual cases.
Warning and critical thresholds for pass rate drops.
A dashboard outline that tracks trends, failures, and dimension averages over time.

best_practices: Define quality dimensions before writing tests or scoring logic.
Report per-dimension scores alongside any overall score.
Use representative test sets and review production samples with humans.
anti_patterns: Testing only one happy path and treating it as proof of quality.
Optimizing one aggregate score while ignoring critical dimension failures.
Using clean test prompts that do not reflect real context size or tool behavior.

faq.question: What does this skill help evaluate?
faq.answer: It helps evaluate agent outputs, regression suites, quality gates, context strategies, and production quality trends.

faq.question: Can it replace human evaluation?
faq.answer: No. It recommends human review for edge cases, unusual queries, and high-impact decisions.

faq.question: Does it include runnable code?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a Python evaluator example for rubrics, test sets, summaries, and production monitoring concepts.

faq.question: Does it design LLM judge prompts?
faq.answer: Only at a general level. Detailed judge design, calibration, and bias mitigation are outside this skill.

faq.question: How should teams start using it?
faq.answer: Start with clear quality dimensions, then build a representative test set and baseline before changing the agent.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
